desc:
TAKE IT WITH YOU: This Cheerios individual cereal cup is great to grab and go; Enjoy it as part of breakfast; Pack one for an after school snack, a treat in the car, or anytime you need a tasty snack on the move

TASTY LITTLE Os: A delicious toasted whole grain oat cereal that the whole family can enjoy

SIMPLY MADE: Contains 32g whole grain per serving (at least 48g recommended daily); Made without artificial flavors or artificial colors

GLUTEN FREE AND MORE: Part of an easy gluten free breakfast or snack on the go; This cereal is a good source of vitamin D

CONTAINS: Twelve single serve plastic cups of crunchy Original Cheerios Single Serve Cereal Cup, 1.3 oz; perfect for instant snacking, or a part of breakfast and meals
features:
Key Features:

100% Whole Grain Oats: Delivers around 34g of whole grains per serving, contributing to daily fiber needs.

Certified Gluten-Free: Carefully processed and tested to ensure it's safe for individuals with gluten sensitivities.

Heart-Healthy Formula: Includes soluble fiber from oats, which may help reduce cholesterol.

No Artificial Colors or Flavors: Clean, simple ingredients with nothing unnecessary added.

Fortified with Essential Nutrients: Contains 11–12 vitamins and minerals, including iron, calcium, vitamin D, and B vitamins.

 Benefits:

Supports Heart Health: Oat fiber helps lower bad cholesterol (LDL) when part of a diet low in saturated fat and cholesterol.

Great for Digestive Wellness: High in fiber, especially soluble fiber, to support regularity and gut health.

Low Sugar Option: Typically contains just 1–2g of sugar per serving, making it suitable for people limiting sugar intake.

Versatile: Enjoy it with milk, yogurt, or as a dry snack; loved by both kids and adults.

Safe for Gluten-Free Diets: Ideal for people with celiac disease or gluten intolerance.

Portion-Controlled Choices Available: Comes in various pack sizes including single-serve cups and family-size boxes.
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Corn Starch, Sugar, Salt, Tripotassium Phosphate. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
